as_told.title: Lone gray craft in trouble over the Plains of San Agustin
as_told.place_text: Plains of San Agustin, New Mexico

plain: This story says that in 1947 a flying saucer crashed on the Plains of San Agustin, a wide, flat stretch of New Mexico. According to the story's title, dead aliens and one live alien were found. A researcher named John Brandenburg tells it on a podcast. He says that around the morning of the 4th of July an object came down on the plains about 100 miles away. A second man, Charles Hall, who says he spent three years among tall white aliens at Area 51, a secret US military site in Nevada, mentions the same crash. Hall describes it as a craft in deep trouble over the plains in 1947. He does not talk about any dead or living beings. If true, it would mean an alien craft fell to Earth and was found in the American desert.
